_comment: Integrated-topic map for relationship.suggest's rule (b) (plan Phase 6.5). Clauses 4-7 and 9-10 follow the same Annex SL (High Level Structure) numbering across ISO 9001:2015/14001:2015/45001:2018, so most topics share one clause list; clause 8 (Operation) diverges in meaning per standard, so those topics are keyed per standard instead. Only the 15 topics the plan names are mapped — sub-clauses with no obvious home (resources 7.1, awareness 7.3, design/production/etc. 8.2-8.7 on 9001, planning of changes 6.3) are deliberately left unmapped rather than forced into a topic that would mislead a suggestion; they still participate in rules (a) and (c).
